name: Bastet
title: Daughter of the Sun
summary: Unleash the fires of Ra upon your enemies and bathe in the glory of Ra’s Ultimate Power
lore: The goddess of Aaru’s cats—and through them, protector of its people—is discontent with this new world. Ryven’s threats and sheer chaos are threats too great for her to defend against. As such, Bastet reaches beyond the bounds of her realm using her cats as messengers and spies, seeking other like-minded gods to help the ascendance of Order over Chaos.
